raw.title: Karl Marx
raw.extract: Karl Marx was a German philosopher, social and political theorist, journalist, and revolutionary socialist. He developed the theory of historical materialism to analyse societal development, focusing on class struggle under capitalism and predicting the system's ultimate replacement by communism. Marx co-authored The Communist Manifesto (1848) with Friedrich Engels, and undertook a critique of political economy in his magnum opus, Das Kapital (1867–1894). His ideas and their later development, collectively known as Marxism, have had enormous influence on intellectual, political, and social history, and have inspired revolutionary movements in many countries.
